title: Read Me!
section: 37. Web3 Decentralised App (DApp) Development with the Internet Computer
summary: Short prerequisite notice: the Web3 modules are advanced and assume the earlier course content has been completed.

concepts.heading: Prerequisites
points: The Web3 material sits at the end of the course because it is harder than the earlier sections.
Assumed knowledge: React, vanilla JavaScript, and building both front ends and back ends.
Learners who jumped straight to this section without web development experience should expect difficulty and go back to the earlier parts when confused.

pitfalls: Starting section 37 without React and JavaScript fundamentals.
